{
  "authorities": [
    {
      "dependency_id": "authority.faqs",
      "evidence": {
        "quote": "The streamlined measures set out in the relevant FAQs",
        "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u9.1696"
      },
      "needed_for_control": true,
      "title_or_locator": "Relevant SFC FAQs, including FAQ on SFC Authorization of UCITS Funds; https://www.sfc.hk/en/faqs/Publicly-offered-investment-products"
    },
    {
      "dependency_id": "authority.home_requirements",
      "evidence": {
        "quote": "which comply with the fund’s home jurisdiction requirements",
        "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u5.840"
      },
      "needed_for_control": true,
      "title_or_locator": "Applicable fund home jurisdiction requirements"
    },
    {
      "dependency_id": "authority.existing_process",
      "evidence": {
        "quote": "in accordance with the existing approval or authorisation process",
        "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u10.1809"
      },
      "needed_for_control": true,
      "title_or_locator": "SFC existing approval or authorisation process applicable to pending applications received before 28 November 2025"
    },
    {
      "dependency_id": "authority.forms",
      "evidence": {
        "quote": "3 Please refer to https://www.sfc.hk/en/Forms/products/Investment-products-Forms-and-checklists",
        "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u19.2914"
      },
      "needed_for_control": false,
      "title_or_locator": "SFC Investment products forms and checklists; https://www.sfc.hk/en/Forms/products/Investment-products-Forms-and-checklists"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "action": "Apply the streamlined measures to post-authorisation matters",
      "actor": "SFC",
      "claim_id": "c1",
      "conditions": ["The fund is a UCITS fund as defined in this circular."],
      "evidence": [
        {
          "quote": "The key streamlined measures cover the following post-authorisation matters:",
          "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u3.575"
        }
      ],
      "exceptions": [],
      "kind": "SCOPE",
      "modality": "DESCRIPTIVE",
      "relevance": "CONTROL",
      "statement": "The measures concern post-authorisation matters for UCITS funds.",
      "temporal": [],
      "uncertainty": []
    },
    {
      "action": "Define the covered EU-domiciled UCITS funds",
      "actor": "Circular",
      "claim_id": "c2",
      "conditions": [],
      "evidence": [
        {
          "quote": "For this circular, UCITS funds means (i) Undertakings for Collective Investment in Transferable Securities (UCITS) domiciled in France, Luxembourg, Ireland and the Netherlands",
          "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u17.2556"
        }
      ],
      "exceptions": [],
      "kind": "DEFINITION",
      "modality": "DESCRIPTIVE",
      "relevance": "CONTROL",
      "statement": "The circular's definition includes UCITS domiciled in France, Luxembourg, Ireland and the Netherlands.",
      "temporal": [],
      "uncertainty": []
    },
    {
      "action": "Define the covered UK-domiciled schemes",
      "actor": "Circular",
      "claim_id": "c3",
      "conditions": ["The collective investment scheme is domiciled in the United Kingdom.", "The scheme is authorised as UK UCITS."],
      "evidence": [
        {
          "quote": "(ii) collective investment schemes domiciled in the United Kingdom authorised as UK UCITS.",
          "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u17.2556"
        }
      ],
      "exceptions": [],
      "kind": "DEFINITION",
      "modality": "DESCRIPTIVE",
      "relevance": "CONTROL",
      "statement": "The circular's definition also includes UK-domiciled collective investment schemes authorised as UK UCITS.",
      "temporal": [],
      "uncertainty": []
    },
    {
      "action": "Remove the requirement for prior approval of material investment changes",
      "actor": "SFC",
      "claim_id": "c4",
      "conditions": ["The change concerns a covered UCITS fund's investment objectives, policies or restrictions.", "The change is material.", "The change complies with the fund's home jurisdiction requirements.", "The application transition does not preserve the existing process."],
      "evidence": [
        {
          "quote": "Removing the SFC’s requirement on prior approval for material changes in investment objectives, policies and restrictions which comply with the fund’s home jurisdiction requirements, except for changes that involve novel or complex product features and/or which may have local policy implications.",
          "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u5.840"
        }
      ],
      "exceptions": ["Changes involving novel or complex product features.", "Changes which may have local policy implications."],
      "kind": "PERMISSION",
      "modality": "MAY",
      "relevance": "CONTROL",
      "statement": "Qualifying material changes may proceed without SFC prior approval under the removal announced in the circular, subject to its exceptions and application transition.",
      "temporal": ["Effective 28 November 2025."],
      "uncertainty": ["The relevant FAQs are needed for detailed application; this removal does not itself establish compliance with other requirements."]
    },
    {
      "action": "Exclude changes involving novel or complex product features from the removal",
      "actor": "SFC",
      "claim_id": "c5",
      "conditions": ["The change involves novel or complex product features."],
      "evidence": [
        {
          "quote": "except for changes that involve novel or complex product features and/or which may have local policy implications.",
          "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u5.840"
        }
      ],
      "exceptions": [],
      "kind": "EXCEPTION",
      "modality": "DESCRIPTIVE",
      "relevance": "CONTROL",
      "statement": "The removal of the prior-approval requirement does not extend to changes involving novel or complex product features.",
      "temporal": [],
      "uncertainty": ["The circular does not define novel or complex product features or specify the detailed retained approval process."]
    },
    {
      "action": "Exclude changes potentially having local policy implications from the removal",
      "actor": "SFC",
      "claim_id": "c6",
      "conditions": ["The change may have local policy implications."],
      "evidence": [
        {
          "quote": "except for changes that involve novel or complex product features and/or which may have local policy implications.",
          "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u5.840"
        }
      ],
      "exceptions": [],
      "kind": "EXCEPTION",
      "modality": "DESCRIPTIVE",
      "relevance": "CONTROL",
      "statement": "Potential local policy implications independently exclude a change from the removal; the feature and policy exceptions can also apply together.",
      "temporal": [],
      "uncertainty": ["The circular does not define local policy implications."]
    },
    {
      "action": "Commence the streamlined measures",
      "actor": "SFC",
      "claim_id": "c7",
      "conditions": [],
      "evidence": [
        {
          "quote": "The streamlined measures set out in the relevant FAQs will take effect on 28 November 2025 (Effective Date).",
          "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u9.1696"
        },
        {
          "quote": "and will take immediate effect.",
          "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u1.190"
        }
      ],
      "exceptions": ["Pending applications described in the transition provision remain under the existing process."],
      "kind": "TIME",
      "modality": "DESCRIPTIVE",
      "relevance": "CONTROL",
      "statement": "The implementation provision specifies 28 November 2025 as the Effective Date; the introduction describes the measures as taking immediate effect.",
      "temporal": ["28 November 2025"],
      "uncertainty": ["A separate circular publication date is not supplied to independently reconcile the introductory wording."]
    },
    {
      "action": "Process pending pre-Effective-Date applications under the existing process",
      "actor": "SFC",
      "claim_id": "c8",
      "conditions": ["The SFC received the application before the Effective Date.", "No approval or authorisation has been granted."],
      "evidence": [
        {
          "quote": "Existing applications received by the SFC before the Effective Date for which no approval or authorisation has been granted will be processed by the SFC in accordance with the existing approval or authorisation process.",
          "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u10.1809"
        }
      ],
      "exceptions": [],
      "kind": "EXCEPTION",
      "modality": "DESCRIPTIVE",
      "relevance": "CONTROL",
      "statement": "Pending applications received before 28 November 2025 remain subject to the existing approval or authorisation process.",
      "temporal": ["Receipt before 28 November 2025.", "No approval or authorisation yet granted at the transition."],
      "uncertainty": ["The contents of the existing process are not supplied."]
    },
    {
      "action": "Facilitate changes subject to home regulator supervision",
      "actor": "SFC",
      "claim_id": "c9",
      "conditions": ["Changes are subject to the fund's home regulator's supervision."],
      "evidence": [
        {
          "quote": "These measures aim at facilitating UCITS funds in implementing changes that are subject to their home regulator’s supervision",
          "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u1.190"
        }
      ],
      "exceptions": [],
      "kind": "SCOPE",
      "modality": "DESCRIPTIVE",
      "relevance": "CONTROL",
      "statement": "The stated aim situates the measures within changes subject to home regulator supervision.",
      "temporal": [],
      "uncertainty": ["The aim statement does not specify whether supervision is a separate eligibility test beyond home-jurisdiction compliance."]
    },
    {
      "action": "Align notification requirements with home jurisdiction requirements",
      "actor": "SFC",
      "claim_id": "c10",
      "conditions": ["Post-authorisation notifications for covered UCITS funds."],
      "evidence": [
        {
          "quote": "To align the SFC’s notification requirements with the fund’s home jurisdiction requirements, including the notice periods and content requirements.",
          "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u6.1221"
        }
      ],
      "exceptions": [],
      "kind": "SCOPE",
      "modality": "DESCRIPTIVE",
      "relevance": "CONTROL",
      "statement": "The measures also align post-authorisation notification requirements, including notice periods and content, with home jurisdiction requirements.",
      "temporal": [],
      "uncertainty": ["No specific notice period or content requirement is supplied; removal of prior approval does not establish absence of notification duties."]
    },
    {
      "action": "Continue post-vetting changes and filed revised documents",
      "actor": "SFC",
      "claim_id": "c11",
      "conditions": [],
      "evidence": [
        {
          "quote": "The SFC will continue to conduct post-vetting of scheme changes (including those not subject to the SFC’s prior approval) and related revised documents filed with the SFC.",
          "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u12.2069"
        }
      ],
      "exceptions": [],
      "kind": "SCOPE",
      "modality": "DESCRIPTIVE",
      "relevance": "CONTROL",
      "statement": "SFC post-vetting continues for scheme changes, including changes exempt from prior approval, and related revised documents filed with the SFC.",
      "temporal": ["Continuing after implementation."],
      "uncertainty": []
    },
    {
      "action": "Make follow-up enquiries or take regulatory action",
      "actor": "SFC",
      "claim_id": "c12",
      "conditions": ["Non-compliance."],
      "evidence": [
        {
          "quote": "It may make follow-up enquiries and/or take appropriate regulatory actions in case of non-compliance to ensure investor protection.",
          "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u12.2069"
        }
      ],
      "exceptions": [],
      "kind": "PERMISSION",
      "modality": "MAY",
      "relevance": "CONTROL",
      "statement": "The SFC may make follow-up enquiries and/or take appropriate regulatory actions in case of non-compliance.",
      "temporal": [],
      "uncertainty": []
    },
    {
      "action": "Provide operational details through relevant FAQs",
      "actor": "SFC",
      "claim_id": "c13",
      "conditions": [],
      "evidence": [
        {
          "quote": "The SFC has updated and published on its website relevant FAQs2 , including a revamped FAQ on SFC Authorization of UCITS Funds",
          "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u7.1419"
        },
        {
          "quote": "The streamlined measures set out in the relevant FAQs",
          "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u9.1696"
        },
        {
          "quote": "2 Please refer to https://www.sfc.hk/en/faqs/Publicly-offered-investment-products",
          "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u18.2831"
        }
      ],
      "exceptions": [],
      "kind": "DEPENDENCY",
      "modality": "DESCRIPTIVE",
      "relevance": "CONTROL",
      "statement": "The circular directs readers to updated relevant FAQs, including the FAQ on SFC Authorization of UCITS Funds, where the streamlined measures are set out.",
      "temporal": [],
      "uncertainty": ["The FAQ text is not supplied."]
    }
  ],
  "uncertainties": [
    "The supplied dependency identifiers missing.1c25ffdf5c1e10e0297748d5 and missing.79fb54125bb1f35a1d457fad have no titles, contents or mapping to cited authorities; no mapping is inferred.",
    "Materiality, novel or complex product features, and potential local policy implications are not defined in the supplied text.",
    "The removal is conditional on home-jurisdiction compliance. The text does not independently establish the approval consequences of non-compliance.",
    "Application-specific eligibility requires the fund domicile and status, nature of the change, applicable home requirements, and any pending application's receipt and approval status."
  ],
  "units": [
    {"claim_ids": [], "disposition": "CONTEXT", "rationale": "General operational-review and investor-protection purpose; no specific approval test.", "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u0.2"},
    {"claim_ids": ["c7", "c9"], "disposition": "CLAIMS", "rationale": "Provides timing and home-supervision context.", "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u1.190"},
    {"claim_ids": [], "disposition": "CONTEXT", "rationale": "Heading identifies the UCITS measures.", "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u2.523"},
    {"claim_ids": ["c1"], "disposition": "CLAIMS", "rationale": "Sets post-authorisation scope.", "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u3.575"},
    {"claim_ids": [], "disposition": "CONTEXT", "rationale": "Separate relief for depository and investment-delegate changes; does not state the rule for investment objectives, policies or restrictions.", "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u4.653"},
    {"claim_ids": ["c4", "c5", "c6"], "disposition": "CLAIMS", "rationale": "Selected approval removal, compliance condition and independent exceptions.", "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u5.840"},
    {"claim_ids": ["c10"], "disposition": "CLAIMS", "rationale": "Related notification requirements qualify the operational effect of relief.", "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u6.1221"},
    {"claim_ids": ["c13"], "disposition": "CLAIMS", "rationale": "Identifies implementing FAQs and associated materials.", "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u7.1419"},
    {"claim_ids": [], "disposition": "CONTEXT", "rationale": "Implementation heading.", "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u8.1677"},
    {"claim_ids": ["c7", "c13"], "disposition": "CLAIMS", "rationale": "Express effective date and FAQ dependency.", "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u9.1696"},
    {"claim_ids": ["c8"], "disposition": "CLAIMS", "rationale": "Preserves the existing process for pending earlier applications.", "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u10.1809"},
    {"claim_ids": [], "disposition": "CONTEXT", "rationale": "Management-company heading; alone imposes no specific duty.", "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u11.2030"},
    {"claim_ids": ["c11", "c12"], "disposition": "CLAIMS", "rationale": "Continued oversight applies even without prior approval.", "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u12.2069"},
    {"claim_ids": [], "disposition": "CONTEXT", "rationale": "Administrative invitation to seek clarification; not a prior-approval condition.", "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u13.2377"},
    {"claim_ids": [], "disposition": "CONTEXT", "rationale": "Issuing division attribution.", "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u14.2489"},
    {"claim_ids": [], "disposition": "CONTEXT", "rationale": "Issuing regulator attribution.", "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u15.2518"},
    {"claim_ids": ["c2", "c3"], "disposition": "CLAIMS", "rationale": "Defines covered funds and jurisdictions.", "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u17.2556"},
    {"claim_ids": ["c13"], "disposition": "CLAIMS", "rationale": "Locator for required FAQ authority.", "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u18.2831"},
    {"claim_ids": [], "disposition": "CONTEXT", "rationale": "Forms and checklist locator supports implementation; no substantive approval test is supplied here.", "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u19.2914"}
  ]
}
